groups.canonical_value: Prioritize coastal lodging near the ocean or beach, without assuming a walking-distance requirement unless explicitly requested.
groups.merge_rationale: This behavior prefers ocean- or beach-adjacent lodging but explicitly does not default to walking distance, so it remains distinct from candidates that inherently prioritize walkable beach access.

groups.canonical_value: Prioritize hotels on or within walking distance of the beach while respecting the stated budget.
groups.merge_rationale: This behavior specifically defaults to on-beach or walkable beach access together with budget filtering, which is more restrictive than a general preference for lodging near the ocean or beach.
